two_defects_this_re_execution_found_in_i.why_it_mattered: a citation longer than the cap could not be compared at all, and in row P02-006 two DIFFERENT citations truncated to the same 16-verse prefix and collapsed into one item - so the truncation did not merely hide detail, it merged distinct claims. two_defects_this_re_execution_found_in_i.defect: the distinct check's class-label normaliser omitted the recount's 'mixed_span_and_seam' spelling and silently upper-cased the unknown label instead
two_defects_this_re_execution_found_in_i.why_it_mattered: it manufactured 3 differences out of agreement - a check that invents disagreement is as dangerous as one that hides it, because the next step is to 'explain' it

an_ambiguity_settled_by_measurement_rath.the_ambiguity: DEF-A4-ARGUED clause 3 says a range is mirrored when 'a boundary_evidence_refs ENTRY covers ... either endpoint or the whole range'. The singular admits a STRICT reading - one entry must do it alone - and the union of entries admits a looser one. They differ only where two different entries cover the two endpoints of one range.
an_ambiguity_settled_by_measurement_rath.what_the_member_does: computes BOTH on every citation and reports every disagreement
an_ambiguity_settled_by_measurement_rath.conclusion: ZERO disagreements across all 145 rows: no citation is mirrored by the union that a single entry does not also mirror. The ambiguity is MOOT on this corpus and needs no ruling. If a later book produces a non-zero count the member will say so and the reading must then be ruled, not chosen.
